operation: Fresh read-only execution capture followed by offline local simulation

acquisition.consistency: Discovery and execution are separate observations. Execution uses one final account batch, not a full validator bank.

result.amount_basis: Unscaled base token units using captured mint decimals; scaled UI and interest-bearing conversions are not requested or applied.
assumptions: The recorded owner is assumed locally to sign; key possession and authorization remain unknown.
Signature and recent-blockhash verification are disabled in the existing LiteSVM 0.16 runtime. Only the fee payer is synthetic; token accounts and deployed program bytes are captured.

Only the selected route and exact input/minimum-output condition are tested. Any missing destination ATA is created by the captured real ATA program, funded by the synthetic fee payer. No conversion, redemption, withdrawal, global exitability or readiness is established.

discovery.scope: One bounded Meteora DLMM PermissionlessV2 version 1 scan for selected mint as Token-2022 X and requested legacy Y, at most four internal-bitmap bin arrays. Not a global market search or best-route ranking.
discovery.selection_rule: Lexicographically first layout-compatible X-to-Y pool; final dependencies verified for this one candidate. No substitution after selection.

logs: Program log: Initialize the associated token account

Program log: AnchorError thrown in programs/lb_clmm/src/instructions/v2/swap2.rs:262. Error Code: ExceededAmountSlippageTolerance. Error Number: 6003. Error Message: Exceeded amount slippage tolerance.

market_parameters.amount_reason: Exact user-selected base token input and explicit minimum paired-token output for this local test; no quote or best execution guarantee.

reconciliation: Amounts reconcile public SPL account amounts; withheld fees are separate extension balances, not additional holder amounts
Failed atomic transaction has zero watched token/withheld deltas; only transaction fee payer may be charged

result.scope: Only this exact source, mint, amount, recipient, fixture, deployed code, runtime and assumed owner signature. No other account, amount, venue or lifecycle path inherits this evidence.
